data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, **1Password is my top recommendation**\.

It's a particularly good balance of security, ease of use, shared password management and administration. It works well for teams that need to share credentials without resorting to spreadsheets, email or messaging apps.

That said, the best choice depends on your budget and how much administrative control you need.

## Best options compared

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password — Best overall**

(My recommendation)

- Excellent user experience.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Security alerts and weak-password monitoring.
- Good administration and employee offboarding.
- Great for non-technical teams.

Teams Starter Pack: US\$24.95/month for up to 10 users. Business: US\$8.99/user/month, billed annually.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Test Bitwarden Premium - Gestionnaire de mots de passe - Que Choisir Ensemble](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hC5M3yQmIFKAAlHcnKpChWSt35-xr8mlIVRywSu-o8DpkerDwLMFxvrII2QFuvOsSP0k6Fo_mQuwr7t8sXrBNPDXf_LEbep8cD4z2PlCIIwWjH4OqBMrEZ0-9cp7BChiCyWOBI7Pq7evrJY8TBbAUMof-Y5H7s49GfDyBJKLiGrh0gHLhDv6TMbIv6ti_DVz?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden — Best value**

- Open-source software.
- Strong encryption and security features.
- Shared collections for team credentials.
- Good administration and audit logs.
- Self-hosting options.

Teams: US\$4/user/month, billed annually.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper — Best for administration**

- Strong access controls.
- Shared team folders.
- Detailed security policies.
- Good compliance-oriented features.

Business Starter: from US\$2/user/month, billed annually.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass — Best privacy-focused alternative**

- Strong privacy focus.
- End-to-end encryption.
- Shared vaults.
- Useful alias and email privacy features.

[Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

*Prices are indicative USD prices, generally with annual billing; check Australian pricing and GST at checkout.* Comparisons: [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[cybercred.com.au](https://cybercred.com.au/articles/password-managers-compared-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd choose

| Team situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| 2–10 employees | 1Password |
| Budget-conscious | Bitwarden |
| IT or technical team | Bitwarden |
| Non-technical employees | 1Password |
| Compliance-heavy business | Keeper |
